responsibility: This file is the handwritten preamble included at the start of autogenerated generic-match.cc, supplying the headers and target-independent helper predicates that the generated GENERIC simplifier patterns rely on. It defines small semantic adapters such as types_match, single_use, canonicalize_math_p, and vector-lowering phase checks so that the code emitted by genmatch for GENERIC folding can query compiler state and apply match.pd transforms with the right phase-specific behavior.
